🚧 Traffic Advisory – Narsingi - Manchirevula Bridge Road 🚧

The Manchirevula to Narsingi village road remains closed due to heavy water flow over the bridge, following the release of water from Osmansagar gates and recent rains. 🌧️

 Traffic diversion is in place, and commuters are advised to avoid the stretch and use alternate routes until further notice.

Our teams are continuously monitoring the situation in coordination with local authorities.
